title: Indian and Sanskrit Mathematical Classics: Original LaTeX and English Translation Drafts
description:
Public corpus page for Indian and Sanskrit mathematical classics in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record exposes reader PDFs directly and keeps source material in a filtered ZIP artifact.

Status at a glance. [########--] 11 reader/index PDFs present; [######----] working drafts for checking and continuation; [----------] not a proofed critical edition.

Contents.

  • 00 Index - Indian and Sanskrit Mathematical Classics.pdf
  • 01 Indian Classics - Combined English Translation Drafts.pdf
  • 02 Indian Classics - Combined Original-Language Drafts.pdf
  • 10-07 English Translation - Aryabhata - Aryabhatiya.pdf
  • 10-08 English Translation - Bhaskara II - Bijaganita, parts 1-3.pdf
  • 10-09 English Translation - Bhaskara II - Lilavati.pdf
  • 10-10 English Translation - Brahmagupta - Brahmasphutasiddhanta.pdf
  • 50-01 Indian Original - Aryabhata - Aryabhatiya.pdf
  • 50-02 Indian Original - Bhaskara II - Bijaganita, parts 1-3.pdf
  • 50-03 Indian Original - Bhaskara II - Lilavati.pdf
  • 50-04 Indian Original - Brahmagupta - Brahmasphutasiddhanta.pdf

Provenance. This page is derived from the current consolidated non-European mathematics release. The source ZIP contains filtered TeX/source artifacts for this corpus; the complete as-received raw provenance archive is preserved on the consolidated record. The workflow collects source scans and reference texts, converts them into TeX drafts, checks them into readable PDFs, and publishes source artifacts for inspection and correction.
notes: Corpus-level public page with reader PDFs first and filtered TeX/source artifacts later.
